verdict.rationale: BAMF publishes its own non-statutory explainers: sections describing the preconditions for living in Germany, FAQs on recognising foreign qualifications, a page on the Skilled Immigration Act, an asylum-procedure overview and an explainer video. It also offers multilingual advisory service teams. None of this is shown to be step-by-step or aimed at a founder's task, such as residence for self-employment or starting a business. Missing for 10: founder- or self-employment-specific guidance, evidence of step-by-step walkthroughs rather than topic overviews, independent confirmation that the content is readable by non-lawyers.
